fixes.explanation: Wrath is the word. The text says they abandoned the house of the LORD and served the Asherah poles and idols. Then it says, “So wrath came upon Judah and Jerusalem for this guilt of theirs.” That little “So” ties the wrath to what they had just done. I think that's worth slowing down for, because the text doesn't leave us guessing why it came.

problems.problem: The explanation still mostly repeats the verse; its observation about “So” does not add a distinctive thought.
